The disc runs itself on two valves and two logic gates:
- A Directive Hatch on §9Quasar: Disc§r (Code mode, window 5). [1] → a valve of 10 units of the feed gas a second into a plain trim hatch (an AE2 fluid export bus with a redstone card, or a GT Fluid Regulator cover set to enable with signal). [2] → a valve of 10 units of Spatially Enlarged Fluid.
- (Disc [4] AND NOT the Eye's Galaxy Transition [8]) OR Galaxy Transition [4] → the quasar's Burst Control Hatch in Purge mode: one AND-NOT gate and one OR gate.
- ME stocking hatches in the 24 gas sockets, and f 1.0 in the GUI.

OpenComputers instead: bts_quasar.trim("gas" or "space", units), purge(), setFeed(f), setField(b), getDisc().

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r your quasar holds its disc on its own (tick the box).
